2026: 71-seat source party scenario, source party-seat S inventory and206-known-candidate readiness companion only; no candidate shares or national scenario

candidatePolicy.R: accepted same person in the dominant predecessor; frozen source normalized residual; broad primary/strict sensitivity
candidatePolicy.S: predecessor-flat source group-row to supported destination; no person identity requirement; printed working approximation
candidatePolicy.approximate_90: guaranteed lower bounds >=90/100 in BOTH directions, unique dominant predecessor; broader development scenario
candidatePolicy.approximate_95: guaranteed lower bounds >=95/100 in BOTH directions, unique dominant predecessor
candidatePolicy.cancelled: no source behavioural S/R; valid party votes remain usable
candidatePolicy.linkageAmendment: only geographically refused Stage26 direct edges in admitted 2014/2020 predecessor pairs are reassessed using unchanged name/context/election-wide competitor/component guards; no prior adjudication overwritten, no new person grouping
candidatePolicy.maori: population/party inputs and evidence inventoried; no general candidate coefficient extension
candidatePolicy.outsideTier: neutral exponent fallback, not zero observed strength; existing missing-table/mapping abstentions retained

geography: Stage25 historical canonical; Stage40 2026 frame mapped into same rational fields; original files unchanged

historicalDiagnostic.commonPopulation: available complete general slates in cumulative two-sided90; all six branches use these identical IDs
historicalDiagnostic.eligibility: outcome-independent source evidence/candidature/geography; target votes and winner score only
historicalDiagnostic.exactFeatures: retain in every corresponding broad/strict branch; no changed-boundary feature transfer in fallback
historicalDiagnostic.fits: saved Stage33 primary constructed-input expanding-window S+R parameters/means, applied to observed local party inputs
historicalDiagnostic.gainSign: fallback_error minus transport_error, positive is improvement
historicalDiagnostic.influence: five largest absolute paired contest effects, retain all primary observations
historicalDiagnostic.metrics: contest-equal MAE, sqrt(mean contest MSE), candidate-equal sensitivity; candidate-equal group bias; full-slate bias accounting
historicalDiagnostic.strict: same PRIMARY fit/means; only R linkage view changes, including exact records; compare with corresponding strict fallback
historicalDiagnostic.training: no refitting, no recentering, no later parameters

partyScenario.choice: lexicographically minimum integral feasible population network vertex
partyScenario.constraints: all preserved group intervals, suppression bounds and exact destination controls; no marginal midpoints
partyScenario.meaning: chosen feasible mean-input scenario under uniform within-source population-to-party-vote allocation; not an observed reconstruction or identified expectation
partyScenario.nationalReconciliation: not imposed; source party mass conserved over complete target population
partyScenario.ordering: (groupId, sourceCode, targetCode) ascending; sequentially minimize each flow with earlier flows fixed
partyScenario.partyVotes: sum_source observedSourcePartyVotes * w; valid-party denominator transported with same weights
partyScenario.solver: HiGHS dual simplex; primal/dual tolerance1e-9; certify integral witness exactly, else abstain

stop: no extra thresholds, fits, new sources, national comparisons or live forecast; S+Rpreferred/Sactive/baselinecontrol; operational records unchanged
uncertainty: overlap does not bound candidate error; no transport variance/calibrated win probabilities; assumptions carried to next joint uncertainty layer
